input.question: Why it is so hard to remember our dreams ?
input.ground_truth: because they're considered irrelevant by our brains. you can train yourself in recollection. that's done mostly by writing down any shreds you do remember, as quickly as you can after you've had the dream.

Explain the following question in a simple way as if you are explaining to a 5-year-old.

Question: Why it is so hard to remember our dreams ?

Answer:

response.prediction: Okay! Imagine your brain is like a little box where you put toys (which are your dreams). When you sleep, you play with lots of toys in that box, but when you wake up, the box gets shaken and most of the toys fall out. That’s why it’s hard to remember your dreams when you wake up. Your brain forgets most of them really fast!
